input.summary: Add Commerce One indemnity limbs for breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 8 gives us only an IP infringement indemnity, so we have added the standard limbs covering Commerce One's breach of law, Commerce One-caused unauthorized access to data, and its gross negligence or wilful misconduct, using the same notice and defence procedure as Section 8.1. Our position is that the vendor should stand behind third-party claims caused by its own misconduct; if helpful, we can accept these limbs being subject to the Section 9 framework other than the IP indemnity carve-out.

ops.text: 8.3 Additional Indemnity. Commerce One shall also indemnify, defend and hold harmless Corio, its affiliates and its Customers from and against any and all damages, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees) arising out of any third-party claim to the extent resulting from (i) Commerce One's breach of applicable law; (ii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Corio's or its Customers' data caused by Commerce One; or (iii) Commerce One's gross negligence or willful misconduct. The notice, tender of defense and cooperation procedures set forth in Section 8.1 shall apply to any claim under this Section 8.3.
